cat.billing.heading: Podpis in računovodstvo
cat.billing.a1:
Go to the Portal preklica, enter the email address on your account, and follow the steps. It takes under a minute.

There is no phone call, no chat queue, and no requirement to explain yourself. If you would rather email, write to podpora@globaliqreport.com In mi bomo obdelali za vas.
cat.billing.a2:
Yes. After the 7-day trial, GlobalIQ bills $29.99 per month and renews automatically until you cancel.

Pred prvim 29.99 dolarjem pošljemo e-pošto s opomnom, ki prikazuje znesek, datum in povezavo za preklic.
cat.billing.q3: Kaj točno imam obtožbo in kdaj?
cat.billing.a3:
• Today: $1.00 za 7 dni dostopa.
  • Day 8: $29.99, unless you cancelled first.
  • Po tem mesečno: $29.99 on the same date each month.

Odpovedati pred osmim danom in 29.99 $ ni nikoli zaračunavano.
cat.billing.q4: Odpovedal sem. Zakaj se lahko še vedno prijavim?
cat.billing.a4: Cancelling stops future charges but does not cut off access immediately. You keep your account until the end of the period you have already paid for, then it lapses.
cat.billing.a5:
Subscription charges are nonrefundable. If you write to us we will review your situation and make a determination, but a review is not a promise of a refund.

Napake v obračunovanju so različne in se vedno popravljajo v celoti: dvojni stroški, stroški po veljavni odpovedi, napačni zneski ali plačila, ki jih niste odobrili. Politika vračila.
cat.testresults.heading: Vaš test in rezultati
cat.testresults.a1:
Rezultat se prikaže takoj, ko končate test in vam pošljemo potrdilo na naslov, ki ste ga vnesli.

If it has not arrived, check your spam folder first, then confirm you entered the address correctly. Email us and we will resend it.
cat.testresults.a2:
GlobalIQ je namenjen izobraževanju in zabavi.To ni klinična ocena, ga ni upravlja psihologa in ni enakovredna instrumentih, kot so WAIS ali StanfordBinet.

Treat your score as a snapshot taken under particular conditions. Tiredness, distraction, screen size, and how familiar you are with this style of question all move the number.
cat.testresults.q3: Lahko uporabim svoj rezultat za prijavo za zaposlitev ali za zaposlitev v šoli?
cat.testresults.a3: No. Our result is not a professional evaluation and should not be used for employment, academic placement, medical purposes, or membership applications. If you need a formal assessment, see a licensed psychologist.
cat.testresults.a4: Yes, while your subscription is active. Bear in mind that familiarity with the question format tends to lift scores on a second attempt, so a higher number is not necessarily a meaningful change.
cat.account.heading: Račun in podatki
cat.account.q1: Kako spremenim e-pošto na svojem računu?
cat.account.a1: Email podpora@globaliqreport.com from the address currently on the account and tell us the new one. We will move it across and confirm when it is done.
cat.account.a2:
Email podpora@globaliqreport.com Iz vašega računa in prosite za izbris.

To ni isto kot preklic. Deleting cancels any active subscription immediately with no refund, permanently erases your results and history, and cannot be undone. If you only want to stop paying, cancel instead.

Requests are completed within 30 days. We keep limited billing records where tax law requires it.
cat.account.a3:
Vaš e-poštni naslov, rezultat in datum, ko ste se odločili za test, kako ste se preselili po spletni strani in omejene podatke o plačevanju iz Stripe ali PayPal - nikoli polna številka kartice.

Our Politika zasebnosti v celoti določa, vključno z načinom, kako zahtevati kopijo.
cat.account.a4:
Check spam and promotions folders, and search for globaliqreport.com. Certificates and receipts occasionally get filtered.

Če se ne bo nič zgodilo, nam pošljite e-pošto in preverimo naslov.

cat.legal.a2: Sporazum, ki zajema vašo naročnino, račun in odpoved. Preberite pogoje.
cat.legal.a3: Kaj shranimo na vaši napravi in kako jo izklopiti. Preberite politiko piškotkov.
cat.legal.a4: Ko bomo vrnili denar, ko ne, in kako vprašati. Preberite politiko vračila.
